OpenAI has already made six acquisitions in 2026, nearly as many as it made in all of 2025, according to Crunchbase data. Its latest purchase took place on March 19, when it announced plans to acquire Astral, a creator of open-source tools for software developers. The most expensive deal — at least among transactions for which a sales price was revealed — was its May 2025 acquisition of Io. OpenAI paid $6.5 billion for the then 1-year-old startup, which developed AI-powered devices.

However, not all of OpenAI’s proposed acquisitions have worked out. Last July, news broke that its planned $3 billion purchase of Windsurf had fallen apart.

ChatGPT release notes
Review the latest updates and release notes for ChatGPT.
Updated: 2 days ago
November 13, 2026
Introducing ChatGPT Wallet
ChatGPT Wallet helps your dot go from finding what you need to making a purchase on your behalf. Whether you’re shopping for a new sweater or booking a hotel, you can ask your dot to help and use Wallet when it’s time to check out. Save an eligible card once, then approve purchases without entering your payment details again.
Before your dot pays, you review the merchant, items, total, and selected card, then authorize the purchase using biometrics such as Face ID or Touch ID. Wallet provides a substitute payment credential for checkout, keeping your actual card details hidden from the agent and business. You retain the rewards associated with your card and its protections for qualifying disputes.

Source: https://help.openai.com/en/articles/6825453-chatgpt-release-notes
Title: ChatGPT release notes | OpenAI Help Center
Content: Wallet is rolling out gradually in dots to ChatGPT Pro subscribers age 18 or older in the United States, with an eligible US-issued card and US billing address. To get started, ask your dot to add a card to Wallet. Some websites may not support purchases made by agents, and approval alone doesn’t confirm an order—check the merchant’s confirmation after checkout. For setup and purchase guidance, see: Making purchases with ChatGPT Wallet.
November 10, 2026
Retiring Advanced and Standard Voice
We’re retiring Advanced and Standard voice from ChatGPT Voice on December 11, 2026.
In July, we introduced GPT-Live, our latest voice model that combines natural conversation with frontier intelligence. Since then, voice usage has nearly doubled, and virtually all people using voice in ChatGPT now use GPT-Live. This change will allow us to simplify the voice experience and focus on improving GPT-Live.

Composer predictions in Codex
Composer predictions, available in beta, suggests your next message based on the conversation in your current Codex thread. After Codex responds, a suggestion may appear in the message box. Press Tab to accept it, then review or edit it before sending. Accepting a suggestion doesn’t send it automatically.
The beta is available to personal ChatGPT Pro users aged 18 and older in all supported regions, in the latest Codex desktop app. It supports local and SSH threads using GPT-6 Astra or GPT-6.1 Sol. Predictions are on by default; turn off Show predictions in the Composer section of General settings. During the beta, generating predictions doesn’t count toward Codex usage limits or consume credits. Messages you send, including accepted predictions, follow normal Codex usage limits and billing.

OpenAI’s Biggest Acquisitions in 2026
By ShravanMay 21, 2026No Comments7 Mins Read
OpenAI went from a research lab that barely did M&A to the most acquisitive AI company in the world in the space of two years. It made one acquisition in 2023, two in 2024, and then something shifted. In 2025, it completed eight acquisitions including the $6.5 billion purchase of Jony Ive’s hardware startup io. By March 2026, it had already matched nearly all of 2025’s deal count with six more purchases. The company has now confirmed 17 acquisitions since 2023. Below is a full breakdown of every confirmed deal, plus the Windsurf saga, the most dramatic M&A collapse in recent AI history.
Key Takeaways
OpenAI has completed 17 confirmed acquisitions between 2023 and May 2026

Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/OpenAI
Title: OpenAI - Wikipedia
Content: DeployCo employs forward-deployed engineers who work with client organizations to deploy AI systems. The Financial Times compared the approach to the deployment model used by Palantir Technologies, which popularized the forward-deployed engineering role.[109][110] At its launch, DeployCo agreed to acquire AI consulting and engineering firm Tomoro, adding approximately 150 engineers and deployment specialists.[107][111] In July, DeployCo agreed to acquire Northslope, an applied AI company founded by former Palantir employees.[112]
Acquisitions
In August 2023, it was announced that OpenAI had acquired the New York-based start-up Global Illumination, a company that deploys AI to develop digital infrastructure and creative tools.[113]
In June 2024, OpenAI acquired Multi, a startup focused on remote collaboration.[114]

OpenAI Group PBC is an American artificial intelligence (AI) public benefit corporation (PBC) headquartered in San Francisco, California.[9] It develops "frontier" generative AI models, particularly its generative pre-trained transformer (GPT) series of large language models.
Its release of ChatGPT in November 2022 accelerated an AI boom, leading to widespread use of generative AI; as of September 2026[update], ChatGPT is the fifth-most-visited website globally.[10][11] OpenAI also releases the GPT Image models and Codex, an AI coding agent. # Pre-Meeting Briefing Report: OpenAI
**Meeting Date:** November 20, 2026  
**Prepared By:** Corporate Intelligence & Business Analysis Unit  
**Current Date Context:** November 15, 2026  

---

## Recent Developments

OpenAI has undergone a massive structural and operational pivot through late 2025 and 2026, transitioning from a pure-play AI research organization into an aggressive, acquisitive enterprise titan operating as an AI Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) ([Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/OpenAI)). Headquartered in San Francisco, California, the company employs approximately 4,500 personnel ([Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/OpenAI)). Following a massive funding round in March 2026, OpenAI achieved a post-money valuation of US$852 billion, establishing it as one of the world's premier artificial intelligence entities, competing closely with Anthropic ([Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/OpenAI)). 

The last 30 days leading up to mid-November 2026 have been marked by aggressive ecosystem expansion, product rollouts, and strategic financial maneuvers. Most notably, OpenAI announced the introduction of the "ChatGPT Wallet" on November 13, 2026, enabling autonomous agents (referred to as "dots") to perform end-to-end ecommerce transactions on behalf of users, such as booking hotels or purchasing apparel, backed by biometric authorization via Face ID or Touch ID and substitute payment credentials ([OpenAI Help Center, 2026](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/6825453-chatgpt-release-notes)). Furthermore, OpenAI announced the retirement of Advanced and Standard voice models scheduled for December 11, 2026, consolidating voice capabilities entirely into GPT-Live following a doubling of voice usage ([OpenAI Help Center, 2026](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/6825453-chatgpt-release-notes)).

M&A activity has intensified dramatically. OpenAI recorded 30 total acquisitions to date, hitting a high-water mark with 17 transactions completed in 2026 alone ([Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-openai/__kElhSG7uVGeFk1i71Co9-nwFtmtyMVT7f-YHMn4TFBg)). The latest acquisition occurred in November 2026 with the purchase of Odessia, a provider of automated flight and hotel travel planning services founded in 2026 ([Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-openai/__kElhSG7uVGeFk1i71Co9-nwFtmtyMVT7f-YHMn4TFBg)). Earlier major 2026 moves included the $6.5 billion acquisition of Jony Ive’s hardware startup *io*, developer tool platforms like *Astral* (creators of Ruff and uv), and strategic plays across developer infrastructure and healthcare ([AIFundingTracker, 2026](https://aifundingtracker.com/openai-biggest-acquisitions)).

Financially, OpenAI's trajectory is defined by immense capital outlays and high cash burn. Operating loss escalated to US$20.92 billion in 2025 (up from US$8.78 billion in 2024), with projected annual expenditures scaling to $17 billion in 2026, $35 billion in 2027, and $45 billion in 2028, largely driven by infrastructure, compute, and proprietary chip development ([Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/OpenAI)).

## Talking Points

* **Agentic Commerce and ChatGPT Wallet Integration:** OpenAI is systematically expanding past simple conversational interfaces into transaction layers. The launch of ChatGPT Wallet allows AI dots to execute purchases securely, signaling a major strategic push into ownership of end-user workflows and digital commerce ([OpenAI Help Center, 2026](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/6825453-chatgpt-release-notes)).
* **Hyper-Aggressive M&A and Ecosystem Consolidation:** Having completed 17 acquisitions in 2026 alone—spanning consumer hardware ($6.5B acquisition of *io*), developer tooling (*Astral*), and automated travel (*Odessia*)—OpenAI is actively buying up technical talent and product pipelines to capture the entire AI stack ([AIFundingTracker, 2026](https://aifundingtracker.com/openai-biggest-acquisitions), [Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-openai/__kElhSG7uVGeFk1i71Co9-nwFtmtyMVT7f-YHMn4TFBg)).
* **Massive Financial Burn vs. Valuation Growth:** Despite an astounding valuation of $852 billion, OpenAI faces steep financial pressures with an operating loss exceeding $20 billion in 2025 and projected expenditures scaling toward $45 billion by 2028 ([Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/OpenAI)). Discussions should address how compute expenditure and proprietary infrastructure strategies impact path-to-profitability timelines ahead of an anticipated IPO.
* **Consolidation of Voice and Developer Offerings:** The phase-out of legacy Advanced and Standard voice modes in favor of GPT-Live underlines a strict product streamlining strategy aimed at scaling frontier multimodal experiences ([OpenAI Help Center, 2026](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/6825453-chatgpt-release-notes)).
